name: ScriptFlow
description: ScriptFlow is a clinically-aware pharmacy prior authorization orchestrator. Given a rejected pharmacy claim, it classifies the issue, scores patient-safety urgency (Tier 1 Critical / Tier 2 High / Tier 3 Standard), extracts FHIR clinical evidence, drafts a pre-filled PA form or appeal letter, and produces a complete 5T deliverable: Talk (pharmacist briefing), Table (case snapshot), Template (PA form), Transaction (simulated submission), and Task (follow-up work item). Built for the Agents Assemble hackathon, May 2026.

skills.name: Resolve Prior Authorization Case
skills.description: Takes a pharmacy rejection or denial and produces a complete PA workflow plan: classification, urgency triage, evidence gathering, pre-filled PA form, simulated submission, and follow-up task.
examples: Patient was prescribed Ozempic. Aetna rejected it for step therapy. Patient has T2DM and ASCVD. Please resolve.
PA for adalimumab was denied for moderate plaque psoriasis. Patient failed methotrexate. Draft an appeal.
Apixaban claim rejected as not covered. Patient is on chronic anticoagulation for AFib. What now?
